subject: Genetics
title: Somatic vs. Germline
description: A fast breakdown of Somatic vs. Germline for builders.

hook.text: A mutation in your skin cell stays with you. A mutation in your egg or sperm cell changes your descendants.

buildup.text: Somatic mutations affect only the person who has them. Germline mutations are passed to every future generation.

discovery.text: Most cancers come from somatic mutations—accumulated damage in one cell line. They die when you die.

twist.text: Germline mutations are rarer but far more powerful. Every cell in your child carries that change forever.

climax.text: Evolution only sees germline mutations. Somatic ones vanish with the individual. The germ line is the river of life.

punchline.text: Your body's mutations die. Your germ cells' mutations live on.
